title: Compile demonstrations into a small function-vector code
hypothesis: On four decoder-held-out relation tasks in pinned Pythia-70m, a demonstration feature encoder that predicts a three-dimensional Mirror code and shared decoder will preserve explicit-FV causal quality within 0.10 gold-logprob nats and 0.05 accuracy, use <=0.50x explicit-FV bytes including encoder and codes, save >=80% repeated-query context tokens versus direct ICL, and beat a same-rank linear demo-to-FV compiler by >=0.10 nats in both dev seeds.
physical_object: Frozen Pythia-70m input embedding table and layer-4 residual stream, plus support-derived FV targets for sixteen relation tasks.
mirror_coordinate: A three-scalar code predicted from the mean frozen token embedding of eight demonstration pairs, decoded through a shared 512x3 residual-vector basis.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen support-demonstrated relation functions compiled to small addresses; four function IDs are excluded from compiler training.
controls: No intervention and no demonstration context
Direct in-context demonstrations attached to every query
Rank-three linear demonstration-feature encoder plus shared residual decoder
Rank-three tanh Mirror-code encoder plus shared residual decoder

task.extraction: Reuse the MA-516 frozen tasks, support/evaluation split, teacher-FV extraction, and layer-4 causal evaluator.
task.demonstration_feature: Mean of frozen Pythia token embeddings over concatenated tokenizations of the eight formatted support pairs Input: x newline Output: y, divided by its L2 norm. No labels/task IDs enter the encoder.
task.primary_metric: mean held-out gold candidate log probability on task IDs 12-15

compiler.feature: one 512-dimensional frozen-embedding mean per support set
compiler.linear_control: m=A^T x+a, v_hat=b+B m; same rank, same trainable shapes, same update budget
compiler.teacher: MA-516 extracted support-derived residual-stream FV for each task
compiler.fit_tasks: Only IDs 0-11 are used to optimize encoder and decoder against FV targets.
compiler.heldout_inference: IDs 12-15 are compiled only from their demonstration features; their teacher vectors are used only for offline quality measurement, not the code prediction.
compiler.optimizer: Adam, full batch, learning rate 0.01, zero weight decay, exactly 2000 updates for both learned compilers.
compiler.initialization: Torch RNG seeded with registered seed; encoder and decoder weights iid Normal(0,1/sqrt(512)); biases initialized to zero.
compiler.training_loss: mean squared error between decoded code and teacher FV, over 12 fit tasks and 512 activation dimensions

development.selection: No rank, task, layer, prompt or scale tuning; fixed rank 3 and update count.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if both seeds preserve explicit-FV causal quality within .10 nats/.05 accuracy, meet <=.50x FV payload, save >=80% repeated-query tokens versus direct ICL, and beat the rank-three linear compiler by >=.10 nats.

storage.authority: actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes
paid_objects: direct ICL control's stored token IDs and offsets
explicit FV control's full sixteen-vector bank
storage.common_base: Include pinned model/config/tokenizer bytes once. No teacher FV or reconstruction cache in learned compiler payload.
storage.amortization: Report support tokens at compile time and direct-ICL versus compiled query tokens; no query count is assumed for a storage claim.

compute.hardware: CPU, fixed five-thread limit, no GPU
compute.active_compute_proxy: report encoder/decoder train multiply proxy, demonstration feature extraction embeddings, compiled decode multiply proxy, intervention adds, and query forward sequences
compute.wall_time: separate support extraction, feature extraction, encoder/decoder fit, compilation and query evaluation

gates.PASS: In both dev seeds, Mirror code compiler is within .05 absolute accuracy and .10 mean gold-logprob nats of explicit FVs, <=0.50x explicit FV-bank bytes, saves >=80% query context tokens vs direct ICL, and exceeds same-rank linear compiler by >=.10 gold-logprob nats.
gates.FAIL: Any frozen quality, storage, context-token, or linear-control attribution gate is missed.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned model integrity, split alignment, or deterministic replay fails.

boundaries: Sixteen constrained relation tasks and four compiler-held-out tasks on one 70M model; not broad language understanding.
The encoder is a small conventional hypernetwork; compare it with the linear compiler and charge all encoder/decoder state.
Direct ICL and compiled FV have different support-context and compile/query compute; report both without assuming a query amortization count.
Fresh seeds remain unopened unless every quality, byte, token and attribution gate passes.
